# Codacy

Codacy is an automated code review tool that helps developers monitor code quality, track technical debt, and enforce coding standards across multiple programming languages.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/codacy/.

## Actions

- **Create API Token**: Create a new api token for the authenticated user's account.
- **Delete API Token**: Delete a specific api token from the authenticated user's account.
- **Get Account Details** (read-only): Retrieve details of the authenticated user's account.
- **Get Organization Repositories** (read-only): List all repositories under a specific organization and provider.
- **Get User Organizations** (read-only): List all organizations the authenticated user belongs to.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List all projects accessible to the authenticated user.
